description: The file provides an overview and example implementation of a file observer class that uses filesystem monitoring (specifically inotify on Linux) to detect changes to files or directories and invoke callbacks. It includes code snippets demonstrating how to create such an observer class, register/unregister with the monitoring system, and a sample main() function to simulate usage.

classes.name: FileChangeMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors a specific file or directory for changes using inotify via the Core::FileSystemMonitor API, providing a callback method 'Updated()' invoked upon changes.

methods.name: FileChangeMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that registers the observer with the filesystem monitoring system for a specified path.

methods.name: ~FileChangeMonitor
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the observer if it was registered.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Callback method invoked when the monitored file or directory changes.
